# `ew check`

<!-- Generated by `cargo xtask docs-gen` from bin/ew/api/cli.json and bin/ew/schemas/. Do not edit: change the source and regenerate. -->

1 subcommand path(s). The synopsis lists the flags; `ew help` prints the positional arguments too.

## `ew check`

```text
ew check [--project <project>] [--scheme <scheme>] [--mode <mode>] [--format <format>] [--json] [--lang <lang>] [--out <out>]
```

Stability: preview.

| Flag | Takes a value | Repeatable |
|---|---|---|
| `--project` | yes | no |
| `--scheme` | yes | no |
| `--mode` | yes | no |
| `--format` | yes | no |
| `--json` | no | no |
| `--lang` | yes | no |
| `--out` | yes | no |

**Exit codes**

| Code | Meaning |
|---|---|
| 0 | no unwaived error |
| 1 | unwaived errors |
| 2 | usage and open errors |

**Result** (`--json`): `ew.check-result/1`, schema [`ew.check-result-1.schema.json`](https://github.com/Ironkode787/ElektraWatt/blob/main/bin/ew/schemas/ew.check-result-1.schema.json).

| Name | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `$schema` | `"ew.check-result/1"` | yes |  | The name of this schema. |
| `counts` | [`ResultCounts`](#resultcounts) | yes |  | The counts of open findings per severity and of waived findings. |
| `exit_code` | integer (format `int32`) | yes |  | The exit code of `ew check`: 1 with an unwaived error, else 0. |
| `findings` | array of [`ResultFinding`](#resultfinding) | yes |  | The findings in report order. |
| `mode` | [`ResultMode`](#resultmode) | yes |  | The check mode. |
| `rules` | array of [`ResultRule`](#resultrule) | yes |  | The rules the scheme ran, in report order. |
| `scheme` | string | yes |  | The scheme's name. |

### ResultCounts

The counts of a `CheckResult`.

| Name | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `errors` | integer (format `uint32`, min 0) | yes |  | Open findings at error severity. |
| `infos` | integer (format `uint32`, min 0) | yes |  | Open findings at info severity. |
| `waived` | integer (format `uint32`, min 0) | yes |  | Waived findings (any severity). |
| `warnings` | integer (format `uint32`, min 0) | yes |  | Open findings at warning severity. |

### ResultFinding

One finding of a `CheckResult`.

| Name | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `code` | string | yes |  | The six-digit code. |
| `discriminator` | string | yes |  | The data that tells findings of one rule over the same targets apart. |
| `fingerprint` | string | yes |  | The fingerprint. |
| `fix` | [`ResultFix`](#resultfix) or `null` | no |  | The quick fix, where the rule offers one. |
| `message` | string | yes |  | The message, in the report's language. |
| `page` | string or `null` | no |  | The ID of the page the finding is shown on, if any. |
| `rule` | string | yes |  | The rule ID. |
| `severity` | [`ResultSeverity`](#resultseverity) | yes |  | The effective severity. |
| `state` | [`ResultState`](#resultstate) | yes |  | Open or waived. |
| `subject` | string | yes |  | What the message is about, as printed. |
| `targets` | array of [`ResultTarget`](#resulttarget) | yes |  | The records concerned; the first is the subject. |
| `waiver` | string or `null` | no |  | The waiver's ID, for a waived finding. |

### ResultFix

The quick fix of a `ResultFinding`.

| Name | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `command` | string | yes |  | The command name (`terminal.designate`). |
| `label` | string | yes |  | The label, in English. |
| `params` | any JSON value | yes |  | The command's parameters. |

### ResultMode

The check mode of a `CheckResult`.

| Value | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `"online"` | Online (the drafting checks while editing). |
| `"release"` | Release (`ew check` and the release gate). |

### ResultRule

One rule of a `CheckResult`.

| Name | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `code` | string | yes |  | The six-digit code. |
| `id` | string | yes |  | The rule ID (`EW-TERM-002`). |
| `pack` | string | yes |  | The pack (`EW-TERM`). |
| `title` | string | yes |  | The title, in English. |

### ResultSeverity

The severity of a `ResultFinding`.

| Value | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `"info"` | Info. |

### ResultState

The state of a `ResultFinding`.

| `"open"` | Open. |
| `"waived"` | Waived (the finding names its waiver). |

### ResultTarget
